newsitem.title: EL SALVADOR: El Salvador inflation falls 0.23 pct in May.
newsitem.headline: El Salvador inflation falls 0.23 pct in May.

text.p: The consumer price index in El Salvador declined by 0.23 percent in May compared to a rise of 0.1 percent in April, the Economy Ministry said on Wednesday.
Accumulated inflation for the year was 2.19 percent at the end of May, lower than the level of 3.4 percent through the first five months of 1996, the ministry said in a report.
May's deflation was attributed to lower food prices caused by a oversupply of agricultural products, the report said.
The Salvadoran government has set a goal of inflation between five and seven percent for 1997 compared to the 7.4 percent inflation posted in 1996.
